relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Galcanezumab or LY2951742 is a monoclonal antibody that targets and binds CGRP, therefore inhibiting its physiological activity.

relationships.subject: Erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: It is a fully human IgG2 monoclonal antibody and a potent, selective, and full competitive inhibitor of the CGRP receptor

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: 120 mg sc galcanezumab significantly reduced migraine headache days compared to the placebo

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: There is no doubt that CGRP modulates cephalic pain neurotransmission.

key_findings: Review of phase III and real-world evidence for anti-CGRP/R mAbs (erenumab, galcanezumab, fremanezumab, eptinezumab) in migraine prevention.
Galcanezumab also efficacious in episodic cluster headache.
